ROUTE_SPLIT.description: A cable is drawn as separate pieces that meet end to end away from any item, so the system cannot read it as one route.
ROUTE_SPLIT.fix: Join the pieces into one cable.

RING_LABEL_MISMATCH.description: Ring shapes and ring labels do not match one to one: a ring has no label, or a label has no ring.
RING_LABEL_MISMATCH.fix: Make the rings and their labels match one to one.

WRONG_LAYER.description: An item or its label is drawn on the layer of another type.
WRONG_LAYER.fix: Move it to the suggested layer.

LABEL_MISSING.description: A symbol has no label, while other symbols of its type do.
LABEL_MISSING.fix: Add the label of its type.

LABEL_TYPE_MISMATCH.description: The label names another type than the item it belongs to (for example a joint 36 labelled 144).
LABEL_TYPE_MISMATCH.fix: Correct the label or the item.

LABEL_LENGTH_MISSING.description: A cable label gives its type but no length.
LABEL_LENGTH_MISSING.fix: Write the length in the label.

HANDHOLE_TYPE_MISSING.description: The handhole is drawn but no text next to it says its type (DH, HH-I, HH-II or MH-I to MH-IV).
HANDHOLE_TYPE_MISSING.fix: Type the handhole type next to it.

HANDHOLE_TYPE_UNKNOWN.description: The text next to the handhole is not an accepted type: DH, HH-I (HH1), HH-II (CH) or MH-I to MH-IV.
HANDHOLE_TYPE_UNKNOWN.fix: Correct the text to one of the accepted types.

HANDHOLE_NOT_DRAWN.description: A handhole name is written (like 04A or CH01) but no handhole symbol is drawn at it.
HANDHOLE_NOT_DRAWN.fix: Draw the handhole at the name (or add it with the tool here on a handhole layer), or delete the name if it is not needed.

BOX_NUMBER_DUPLICATE.description: Two boxes in the same cabinet have the same number; a box number must be unique inside its cabinet.
BOX_NUMBER_DUPLICATE.fix: Change the number of one of the two boxes to the right one.

BOX_NOT_REACHED.description: No 1way bundle ends at this box, so it is not clear where it is connected from.
BOX_NOT_REACHED.fix: Fix the drawing in AutoCAD: connect a 1way bundle to the box.

CABINET_BOX_COUNT_MISMATCH.description: The box count written on the cabinet (like 22B) differs from the number of boxes drawn under it.
CABINET_BOX_COUNT_MISMATCH.fix: Correct the number written on the cabinet, or fix the drawn boxes in AutoCAD.

CABINET_ZONE_MISSING.description: There is no zone line (the cabinet area) around this cabinet.
CABINET_ZONE_MISSING.fix: Draw the zone line around the cabinet and its boxes in AutoCAD, or map the zone layer on the mapping screen.

SPARE_CORES_MISMATCH.description: The spare «SP n» is not the main cable cores minus the sum of the branch cable cores.
SPARE_CORES_MISMATCH.fix: Correct the spare number to the right result (written next to each place).

CABLE_SLACK_TOO_SHORT.description: The written cable is not at least 15 m longer than its bundle (or it is shorter than the bundle itself).
CABLE_SLACK_TOO_SHORT.fix: Correct the cable length in its label.

CABLE_SLACK_TOO_LONG.description: The written cable is more than 30 m longer than its bundle. This is a warning only and does not block publishing.
CABLE_SLACK_TOO_LONG.fix: Check the cable length if the number is wrong; if it is right, leave it as it is.

BOX_CABINET_UNKNOWN.description: A box names a cabinet that is not in the drawing. The name may have a typo.
BOX_CABINET_UNKNOWN.fix: Fix the cabinet name written on the box so it matches a cabinet in the drawing.

CABINET_NAME_DUPLICATE.description: Two cabinets in the drawing have the same name; each cabinet needs one unique name.
CABINET_NAME_DUPLICATE.fix: Rename one of the two cabinets.

CONNECTOR_SIZE_MISSING.description: A 1way bundle label has no duct size, so the connector and end-cap size is unknown.
CONNECTOR_SIZE_MISSING.fix: Write the duct size in the bundle label (e.g. 1way 20/16).

reasons.QUANTITY_BELOW_RECORDED: The subcontractor quantity cannot go down to {requestedQuantity}: {recordedQuantity} of work is already recorded on it (pending or approved).
reasons.LINE_HAS_WORK: Cannot remove: work is already recorded on this subcontractor line.

section.title: Subcontractors
section.noWorkOrder: This project has no work order yet. Create the work order first, then register subcontractors on it.
section.none: No subcontractor is registered on this work order yet.
section.totalHint: Quantity × latest price, summed over its lines
section.confirmRemoveRegistration: Remove {name} from the work order, with all its lines and prices?

line.confirmRemove: Remove line {code} from this subcontractor, with its prices?
line.lastLine: The last line cannot be removed; remove the whole registration

import.title: Register a subcontractor from a sheet
import.explain: The lines come from an Excel sheet with code, description, unit, scope of work, quantity and price. An empty scope means the whole line. The first price starts on the registration date.
import.mappingNote: Scope of work is optional; work type is not used.

contractorAccounts.title: Contractor login accounts
contractorAccounts.intro: People of {name} who can sign in to see their lines, prices and recorded work. They can only read.
contractorAccounts.loadFailed: The accounts could not be loaded
contractorAccounts.passwordRule: 12 to 128 characters. Give it to the contractor yourself: no email is sent.
contractorAccounts.created: Account created. Give the password to the contractor yourself.
contractorAccounts.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists
contractorAccounts.confirmStop: Stop the account of {name}? They are signed out and cannot sign in until you restart it.
contractorAccounts.confirmRestart: Restart the account of {name}? They can sign in again.

contractorPortal.title: My work and prices
contractorPortal.pendingNote: Recorded work stays «under review» until it is reviewed; only approved work counts as accepted.
contractorPortal.noRegistrations: You are not registered on any work order yet
contractorPortal.loadFailed: Your data could not be loaded

elementGroups.title: Elements and groups
elementGroups.intro: For each element of the drawing, the main groups the supervisor sees when he taps it. The change applies to all contracts.

unlinked.title: Groups not linked to any element
unlinked.body: The supervisor cannot reach the lines of these groups. Add each one to an element below.

elementGroups.addPlaceholder: Pick or type a group name
elementGroups.stale: The list was changed by another user. Reload the page and try again.

siteDrawings.title: Drawings by site
siteDrawings.noDrawings: This site has no drawings yet
siteDrawings.loadFailed: Could not load the drawings. Try again.

unassigned.title: No site
unassigned.hint: These drawings were uploaded before sites existed. Link each one to a site of the work order once; until then it cannot be published.
unassigned.noSites: The work order has no sites yet, so there is nothing to link to.

refused.GENERAL_EXISTS: This site already has its General drawing. Link a Secondary here, or choose another site.
refused.SITE_NOT_FOUND: That site is not on the work order any more. Choose another one.
refused.ALREADY_ASSIGNED: This drawing is already linked to a site.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this drawing from the site?
withdraw.text: It was never published, so it can leave the site. Its open draft is discarded and the site no longer waits for it.
withdraw.refused: This drawing cannot be withdrawn: it was published before.

upload.title: Upload a drawing
upload.newGeneral: The General drawing of the site
upload.generalExistsHint: This site already has its General. You can only upload a new version of it.
upload.pickTargetFirst: Then say whether it is a new drawing or a new version
upload.label: CAD file (.dwg or .dxf)
upload.hint: The file is read on the server; it can take a few minutes.
upload.noSites: This work order has no sites yet, so a drawing has no site to belong to. Add the sites first in the «Sites» section of the work order page.
upload.openWorkOrder: Open the work order, Sites section

refused.GENERAL_EXISTS: This site already has its General drawing ({file}). Upload a new version of it instead of a second General.
refused.SITE_NOT_FOUND: That site is not on the work order. Choose a site from the list.
refused.DRAWING_NOT_IN_SITE: That drawing does not belong to the chosen site. Choose the drawing again.
refused.DRAWING_UNASSIGNED: That drawing is not linked to a site yet. Link it to a site first, then upload.

publish.note: Publishing covers every draft of this site together, with one revision number.
publish.noDraft: No drawing of this site has a draft to publish.

blocked.SITE_UNASSIGNED: The {drawing} drawing is not linked to a site. Link it to a site first.
blocked.SITE_INCOMPLETE: The site is not complete: it still needs {kinds}.
blocked.CABINETS_MISMATCH: The cabinets of the site do not match: the General has {generalCount}, the Secondaries have {secondaryCount}. Only in the General: {onlyGeneral}. Only in a Secondary: {onlySecondary}. In more than one Secondary: {inSeveral}. Cabinets with no name: {unnamed}.
blocked.CABINET_IN_OTHER_SITE: These cabinet names are already in another site of the work order: {cabinets}. A cabinet belongs to one site only.

notReady.no_revision: it has no revision yet; build it from its file
notReady.queued: it is waiting to be built

cabinets.otherSiteTitle: Cabinet names that another site already has

mobileSites.onPhoneOld: On the phone (revision {revNo}) - newer revision {latest} available
mobileSites.empty: No drawings are published for this project yet.
mobileSites.noSites: You have no sites on this project. Talk to the project manager.
mobileSites.notOnPhoneOffline: This drawing is not on the phone. Connect to the internet to download it.

mobileContractor.title: Contractor
mobileContractor.readOnly: View only. You cannot change anything here.
mobileContractor.offline: No connection. Showing the last saved data.
mobileContractor.noData: No saved data yet. Connect to the internet and pull down to refresh.
mobileContractor.noLines: No lines on this work order.
mobileContractor.noRegistrations: You are not registered on any work order yet.
